annotations.title: Web search API with contents: Exa-style search, filters, page text and highlights

description: Exa-style web search: top 1-20 results with title, URL, snippet, published date and favicon (Brave index); optional domain, date, category and phrase filters; optional live page text, highlights and AI summaries of the top 10 pages. Results are for immediate use only: no storing, resale or model training (Brave API terms). Failures return 503, uncharged. Use when an agent needs current information or sources from the open web. Example: q=x402 payment protocol. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

category.description: news, research paper, github, pdf, tweet, linkedin profile, company, personal site or financial report

endPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or before this date (ISO 8601)

excludeDomains.description: Never results from these domains: comma list or JSON array

excludeText.description: A phrase the results must not contain

highlights.description: true: the passages of each page that best match the query, with scores

includeDomains.description: Only results from these domains: comma list or JSON array, up to 20 (example.com, github.com/org)

includeText.description: A phrase the results must contain (up to 5 words)

startPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-01-01)

summary.description: true: a 1-3 sentence AI summary of each of the top pages

summaryQuery.description: What the summaries should focus on (default: the query)

textChars.description: Return the live page text of the top results, this many characters each (500-20000, or true for 3000; default none)
